title: Hemlock Campgrounds & Cottages

services.name: Woodworking Sign Weekend
services.desc: Arts and Crafts in the morning and sign making at night. You can check out prior sign classes on our facebook page. Come with an idea and we will help you put together a sign that you will cherish for years to come.

services.name: Paint and Sip Weekend
services.desc: Saturday ceramics. Happy Tales will be here to help us all let our inner Picasso out. The cost is $30.00 per person. We will painting a camping scene on a cutting board. There is limited availability so plan ahead

blurb: Hemlock Campground & Cottages is a fun family camping facility centrally located in the heart of the Pocono Mountains of Northeastern Pennsylvania. Our campground features level, wooded campsites for RV’s, tents and pop-ups. Heated and air conditioned Cozy cottages are also available.
